feature: FrameUI prototype drafts, flows and approved canvas import

inspected: DesignIde save queue and undo/redo snapshots
project index, assets, components and font resolution
Claude Code subprocess and private MCP bridge
architecture.decision: Extend VisualDocument with a versioned prototype field. Legacy source-file journey maps retain their separate source-draft purpose; editable artboard flows live with the artboards in the same atomic document.
architecture.before: Claude tool mutations produced a cloned VisualDocument which ClaudePanel immediately applied to the canvas.
architecture.after: Claude tool mutations produce a durable isolated draft. Review and runner use existing native renderers. Explicit approval validates and merges against the current saved document. One existing undo checkpoint covers the import.
architecture.singleSourceOfTruth: Graph edges are derived from the same interaction records executed by PrototypeRunner.
architecture.migration: Existing document version 1 remains readable. Optional prototype schema version 1 migrates legacy per-object interactions without changing artboard IDs.
architecture.persistence: Atomic local JSON files for drafts and canvas; generation interruption retains the previous completed version. Document import receipts make recovery idempotent.
architecture.security: Existing Claude authentication retained. No generated JavaScript execution. Existing source-file and command approvals remain separate from canvas import.

workflow: Create a flow from Flows, add existing or new artboards, and drag handles to connect them. Select a canvas element in the Prototype inspector to define element-level behaviour.
Choose an artboard, flow or new design target in Claude. Generation creates an isolated draft; it does not change the saved canvas.
Review Original and Proposed screens, edit interactions manually, run the local prototype, or request a targeted revision in the same conversation. Restore older draft versions when needed.

Approve and Import opens a concrete confirmation. Validation and conflict checks run again before one atomic save. Existing IDs and unrelated edits are preserved; new artboards receive non-overlapping positions.

prototypeCoverage: real form input and preserved state
simulated disk write failure with full rollback and retry
dragged connection creation, editing and removal
tests.claudeCodeRegression: passed: login, models, streaming, source-write boundary, reference images, cancellation, failure handling and credential isolation
tests.anthropicApiRegression: passed: tool loop, source review/apply/undo, component reuse, commands and runtime comparison
tests.canvasWorkflowRegression: passed: drawing, presets, layout grids, components, offline legacy prototype migration and persistence
tests.mountedDmg: passed: checksum verification and full Electron prototype workflow
tests.note: Prototype generation is tested with deterministic official-CLI protocol fixtures, not a claim of a new live model design-quality evaluation.

limits: Prototype state is local simulation; no application backend or arbitrary project JavaScript is executed.
Generic component-state feedback supports selected, disabled and default states; arbitrary source-component state machines and custom animation systems are not executed.
Approval applies the complete draft; partial screen approval is intentionally not offered.
Undo uses the existing session history; stored designs, flows, conversations and draft versions survive restart.
The review package is macOS x64 and uses the existing unsigned local review-build configuration.
